Twelve comments

I know the key signature is wrong so any guidance on that matter would be greatly appreciated.

I learnt this tune off Jack Talty at the Willie Clancy Summe School and i was just searching for varations but couldnt find the tune…Plenty of tunes called Mountain Dew and the likes but none the same or a variation as far as i could tell.

If this is a copy of a tune already on the database please let me know…

The Morning Dew (Dolan’s Pub)

This transcription was pulled from a YouTube video published in 2015 titled “Dolan’s pub (Limerick, Ireland) - Irish Traditional Music Session.” The squeezebox part is supposedly an attempt at “The Morning Dew” by Tony MacMahon. I enjoyed this live version better, so I transcribed the first verse. I am not sure what are “mistakes” or not, however, taken note for note it’s a gem. The album version is quite different, but similar tonality. Link below:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O9a8pVGa1Mo
